title: Diagnose a failed CI check and repair the workspace until local verify passes
narrative: Fangore's pull request build fails on the checks job. After a forge lookup (see `fangore_coding_ci_diagnose`), he starts guided coding against the project workspace, reads a failure log, repairs the broken source, re-runs the same kind of local verify the pipeline used, and writes a short fix note for the next human review. Static stories plant a failure log so repair stays offline; forge HTTP lookup is owned by the diagnose story. Complements `fangore_coding_ci_diagnose`, `fangore_coding_git_inspect`, and `fangore_coding_git_open_pr`.
implementation: Agentic Recipe catalog id `guided_coding` with `environment.local_work: project_coding`, `ci_seed: failing_check`, and coding tools under `build_coding_tool_registry`. Static stories plant a failure log and broken module; the Completer (or `coding_tool_script: ci_repair`) reads that log, edits the module, and records `.mechaharness/ci_fix.md`. Forge check/job log tools are proven in `fangore_coding_ci_diagnose`. Local re-check uses `ProjectCodingLocalWork` `verify_runs` / `run_python` (and host `run_checks.sh` when bound) so repair stays on the cheap Completer lane. Soft point `external_guidance` remains the human scope gate.
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `repair.yaml` in suite `fangore_guided_coding`. Static mode uses `coding_tool_script: ci_repair` against `ci_seed: failing_check`. Asserts `widget.py` contains the repaired function and `.mechaharness/ci_fix.md` cites the failure. Live Completer may drive the same tools with `MECHA_STORY_BACKEND=live`.
